title: Broski's Player Abilites
description: This Mod adds some player abilities to Minecraft that are super cool! There is things like a double jump and a dash with so much more like a wall climb.
body:
Broski's Player Abilites

Broski's Player Abilites adds a set of powerful movement and combat abilities to Minecraft, giving players a faster, more action-packed way to explore, fight, and survive. With abilities like double jump, dash, wall climb, teleport, super punch, and ground slam, players can move around the world like a superhero and take on mobs in new ways.


Abilities:

Double Jump

Default keybind: Z

Double Jump lets you jump again while you are already in the air. This is useful for reaching higher places, saving yourself from bad jumps, and moving around much faster.

How it works:

Jump normally, then press Z while in the air. You can only double jump once until you touch the ground again.

Dash

Default keybind: R

Dash launches the player forward in the direction they are looking. It is perfect for dodging mobs, crossing gaps, escaping danger, or rushing into a fight.

How it works:

Look where you want to go and press R. The player gets boosted forward with a small upward push.

Wall Climb

Default keybind: Left Alt

Wall Climb lets players climb upward while touching a wall. This makes cliffs, caves, buildings, and mountains way easier to move around.

How it works:

Hold Left Alt while touching a wall. If you are in the air and pushing against the wall, you will climb upward slowly.

Super Punch

Default keybind: H

Super Punch charges your next hit with extra power. When you punch or attack a mob, the target takes bonus damage and gets knocked back.

How it works:

Press H to charge Super Punch, then attack an enemy. Your next hit will deal extra damage and launch the target away.

Teleport

Default keybind: V

Teleport lets players blink forward a short distance. It checks for a safe landing spot before teleporting, making it useful for fast movement and escaping danger.

How it works:

Look where you want to go and press V. If there is a safe space ahead, you teleport forward.

Ground Slam

Default keybind: G

Ground Slam lets you slam down from the air and damage nearby enemies when you hit the ground. It is great for crowd control and dramatic attacks.

How it works:

Jump or fall from the air, then press G. You will slam downward. When you land, nearby mobs take damage and get knocked back.

Config Menu

Default keybind: P

The mod includes an abilities menu that lets you change ability settings. You can adjust things like dash power, double jump height, teleport distance, ground slam damage, and more.

The menu also has a button that opens Minecraft’s normal keybind settings, so players can change the ability keys.

Commands

Server admins and players with permission can customize ability settings using commands.

View current ability settings:

/abilities get

Change dash power:

/abilities set dash_power 2.5

Change double jump height:

/abilities set double_jump_height 1.2

Change teleport distance:

/abilities set teleport_distance 20

Change ground slam damage:

/abilities set ground_slam_damage 20

Change wall climb speed:

/abilities set wall_climb_speed 0.5

Cooldowns use Minecraft ticks:

20 ticks = 1 second

Example:

/abilities set dash_cooldown 20

This makes the dash cooldown 1 second.

Default Keybinds
Z = Double Jump
R = Dash
Left Alt = Wall Climb
H = Super Punch
V = Teleport
G = Ground Slam
P = Open Abilities Menu

(Make sure to change Abilites Menu key if playing on a server)

All keybinds can be changed in Minecraft’s Controls menu.
